title: 广播的内存零拷贝本质与物化爆炸
expected_output:
apparent nbytes = 32000000
real data nbytes = 32
stride dim0 == 0 : True
shares_memory(base, big) : True
materialized nbytes = 32000000
writeable of broadcast view : False
code:
import numpy as np
base = np.arange(4, dtype=np.float64)          # 32 字节
big = np.broadcast_to(base, (1_000_000, 4))    # 零拷贝视图
print("apparent nbytes =", big.nbytes)         # 逻辑大
print("real data nbytes =", base.nbytes)       # 物理小
print("stride dim0 == 0 :", big.strides[0] == 0)
print("shares_memory(base, big) :", np.shares_memory(base, big))
mat = np.array(big)                            # 物化 -> 真分配
print("materialized nbytes =", mat.nbytes)
print("writeable of broadcast view :", big.flags.writeable)
